verdict.rationale: Dover is a recruiting platform with a public API, webhooks and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask, but the evidence documents none. The webhook "Test" button only sends a sample event to an endpoint. That is an adjacent one-off test event, not an isolated sandbox environment that keeps API or agent activity away from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
